- 2026-11-17 — Phase 10, I1 task 10: the action and the browser helpers. `src/app/(caregiver)/private/actions.ts` (`runPrivate`, its only export), `src/lib/private/count.ts` (`countPrivate`: `meta` key `private_count:<YYYY-MM>:<event>`, UTC month, read then write), `session.ts` (`IDLE_MS`, `saveResult`, `loadResult`, `forget`, through `window.sessionStorage` so nothing can be kept in a server process), `hygiene.ts` (`reencode`, `sha256Hex`, `Held`, `prepare`, `toForm`, `MAX_PAGES` 10, `MAX_BYTES` 4 × 1024 × 1024); before it, `copy.ts` gained `H2.same_tier_free`, `H2.same_tier_none` and `peopleWords`. Differs from the runbook: `hygiene.ts` also exports `pixelsOnly`, which `reencode` runs on every redrawn picture to drop the APP1 to APP15 and comment segments, because WebKit's canvas encoder writes a small Exif block of its own (colour space and pixel size, nothing of the original) and the upload e2e asserts no APP1 segment; a third test file, `tests/private/hygiene.test.ts`, covers it with `sha256Hex` and `toForm`. Chosen here, none settled by the runbook: with the demo reader a `file` part beside demo ids is `demo_only` too, and with any other reader a `demo` value beside files is `failed`; parts under other names are ignored; "4 MB together" is the sum of the parts' sizes; the stub reader gets the demo partner and `demo: true`; a redrawn picture gets a white ground; a PDF is known by its first bytes, not its name; a pick is all or nothing, and a refusal leaves the held pages as they were; a page already redrawn at quality 0.6 is not redrawn again; `prepare` never throws (a file that cannot be read is `demo_only` or `format`). The Server Function body limit was already 8 MB in `next.config.ts` (the default is 1 MB), so nothing changed there. For the e2e task: React sends a `FormData` argument's parts under prefixed names (`…_file`), each with the file name `file`; the action sees the names as written. The redraw was run by hand in Chromium and WebKit (a scratch Playwright script, not in the repository). Verified: 363 unit tests, typecheck, `npm run build` (Fable agent).

- 2026-11-17 — Phase 10, I1 task 11 review (four lenses: mock fidelity, behaviour contract, accessibility, code). Fixed. A stop, a refusal and an erase move focus to the status box (`data-notice`, `tabIndex -1`), which sits above the heading and was never announced. A file refused on the phone changes nothing: `prepare` runs before the working rows show, so the screen stays, a result included, with the reason above it; an accepted pick drops the stored result, `Start over` forgets it, and a check that answers after the page was left saves nothing. The 30-minute idle erase shows S13; use also counts a click, a move of focus and a scroll; the saved stamp follows the last use (once a minute, and when the tab is hidden), so a reload inside the window keeps the result. On a screen under 500 px tall (twice the text size, or a phone on its side) the action bar scrolls with the page: measured at 195 by 422, a sticking bar left 2 px of page. The letters carry off-screen words for a screen reader ("Tick box:", "blank", "blank for"); `Copy the text` is left out where there is no clipboard and says "Couldn't copy. Use Print or save as PDF." when refused (both in the feature document §2a); `window.print` is guarded; a file let go beside the guide box no longer opens in the tab. `run.ts`: a possible duplicate is left out of the result, and under "amounts differ" the gap's evidence is the two totals with no bill line. Result: the ceilings line shows only with its table and with no income letter read. Looks: the account-number rule keeps the reference line whole at 390 px; on paper the name sits beside the date (mock PM4b) and a chip is the size of its sentence; the erased box has the circled tick and the mock's distance to the heading; waiting rows draw a clock and done rows set their summary in ink-2 (muted on mint is 4.44:1), both through new `StepRow` props that are off for regular Snap; the placeholder pattern is built from `PLACEHOLDERS`; the cover sheet names the demo hospital as the result does; the standalone phone and form links are 48 px tall. `/snap`: the guide draws the camera glyph of mocks M01 and PM0 in place of the dashed page, so the row "What is private mode?" ends at 670 px, above the bar at 671. Chosen here: a reload's restore does not move focus (with the headings' own focus ring back for keyboard users, a restore would ring the heading before the first tap). Left for a decision: the root font size of 112.5% (every screen is an eighth larger than the mocks); "Next" under a waiting row's title where mock PM2 writes ": next"; the print footer at the foot of every sheet (a fixed footer covers a long letter's text and Safari's print could not be checked); held pages that already fill the limit (the plan keeps them after every stop but "two bills"); the "copy was used" flag across a reload (it changes the stored shape); the count awaited before the answer (`after()` needs a request scope the action's tests do not have); "Attach a copy of the bill and the notice." when no notice was dropped; "(opens in a new tab)" on live-reader links (I3); the shared components' own words "Next" and "Estimated" and the two condition labels typed in §5. Verified: 364 unit tests, typecheck, `npm run build`, the scratch Chromium spec (7 passed) with the affected screens and the four printed pages looked at again.
